name: sync
description: A paired device (a Mac or a Windows PC) sends its own Claude Code session files to the box, once its person turns import on for it (ADR 0008 5a).

tips.text: Before you turn a device's import on, see what it would send: `vyre call sync.scan` lists its project folders with sizes, so you can leave any out.
A paired device's Claude Code sessions come to your box only once you turn its import on; off by default.
Turning a device's import off keeps everything it already sent — the data is yours, not the device's. Delete it on purpose from its page in Settings, or the unpair dialog's unticked option.
